title: BIR / CIR — maintained logical IR contract
description: The compiler's internal interchange contract. Source BIR (kotc→bir2cir) and physical CLR CIR (bir2cir→ilemit) have distinct phase-owned definitions maintained here. Typed records and codecs are generated from those definitions. The source-node profile is still partial during migration; it is not yet a closed reader for every BIR producer. Internal ABI compatibility across compiler versions is not promised.
$comment: A BIR/CIR file is a compilation unit. Executable inline/default carriers use codec bir-msgpack/1; their owning models share this schema's phase vocabulary. KotlinInline's envelope is the birInlinePayload definition. Other metadata carriers such as KotlinSuspendFunctionType still use bir-json/1. Attribute constructors and carrier placement live in spec §0.

typeAliases.description: BIR-only actualized Kotlin alias declarations, encoded opaquely into CIR assemblyAttrs before physical lowering

assemblyAttrs.description: CIR assembly attribute applications, emitted literally after local constructors receive metadata tokens

properties.description: top-level accessor-routed properties, explicitly linked to their file-class accessor methods

refTypes.$comment: BIR-only capture-cell facts. kotc supplies captured typeParams (including their bound closure), elem in that declaration's type frame, and explicit arguments at each use. bir2cir materializes the CLR cell class. Closed cells introduced during inline lowering supply an empty typeParams array. The registry is removed before CIR.

sourceTypeFactsText.$comment: Typed source-phase base, interfaces and bounds. JSON text is produced only for the remaining DOM consumer frontier, not used as the internal representation.

birAttributeLiteral.description: A phase-owned metadata literal, not an executable constant. An absent value denotes an unencodable metadata value; a present null denotes a null literal.

companionReceiver.$comment: Frozen source TypeNode. Typed in kotc; the current JSON wire spells the semantic association as an encoded type string.

argTypes.$comment: Construction parameter types at this application belong to its lexical frame. Unlike call descriptor vectors, owner permutation rewrites these types; memberSignature remains in the target constructor's declaration frame.

utf16Literal.$comment: Lossless string literal payload, not an expression node. Preserves arbitrary UTF-16 code units through UTF-8 JSON and embedded inline/default metadata.

type.description: A Type is ALWAYS an object with a `t` discriminator. There is NO bare-string type. Readers dispatch(t). Kotlin projections must be consumed before CIR; ptr, fnPtr, mod and array ranks are CIR signature facts. Modifiers and ranked arrays also occur inside a function pointer's callable signature even when the pointer occupies an ordinary value slot.

tFqn.description: A named type — a PURE Kotlin/CLR FQN identity. kotc emits identity ONLY; bir2cir DERIVES the CLR form (primitive opcode / generic construction / referenced-type resolution). Replaces plain-FQN, clr:, clrg:Name[..], @Name, and the primitive shorthand (int/string/void/object/…).

name.description: e.g. kotlin.Int, kotlin.collections.List, System.Exception, dotkt$CharSequence (a compiler-generated synthetic — `$` is Kotlin-unspeakable; the def carries generated:true)

classifier.description: Frontend-authored nested Kotlin classifier identity. It does not occur in a physical member signature; contextual signature checks remain in the validator.

tTv.description: A type variable. `scope` is the CLR generic-param SPACE (distinct on the CLR); `i` the owner-local FLATTENED positional index. scope+i map straight to !i / !!i. Replaces gp:X (name-keyed).

scope.description: type → enclosing type's params (CLR !i); method → the method's own params (CLR !!i)

tStar.description: A Kotlin `*` projection. BIR preserves this Kotlin type-system fact; bir2cir lowers it to a provenance-backed CLR existential representation. It is invalid in CIR.

tProjection.description: A Kotlin use-site projection. bir2cir consumes this source fact when selecting a CLR representation.

tFn.description: A function type; subsumes plain AND suspend (the H2 position metadata is just an fn with suspend:true). Replaces func:/sfunc:.

ctx.description: Reference-metadata-only: the CONTEXT parameters of a Kotlin context function type, restored from [KotlinContextFunctionType(N)] while constructing the reference KLIB. `context(A) B.(D) -> E` reads back as ctx=[A], recv=B, params=[D]. kotc BIR MUST omit it — there the fact rides the declaration-slot key `ctxFnType`, because a type node is rebuilt by many lowering passes and would lose it.

clr.description: CIR-only physical delegate family, authored by bir2cir after Kotlin-to-CLR lowering. kotc BIR MUST omit it; every fn that reaches ilemit MUST carry it.

tOblivious.description: T! — an NRT-OBLIVIOUS flexible type (T..T?) (NullableAttribute=0). `oblivious` is the CLR/Roslyn term, not the Kotlin-consumer 'platform' name. Reference-metadata-only: dll2klib serializes the flexible lower/upper bounds into the KLIB, so kotc BIR never emits this node.

rank.description: CIR-only: the rank of a GENERAL ECMA array (the CLR caps it at 32). ABSENT is the SZARRAY `T[]` — the vector, and the only array shape Kotlin source can spell. PRESENT means the general array: rank 2 or more is `T[,…]`, and rank 1 is the single-dimensional non-vector `T[*]`, which ECMA keeps distinct from `T[]` and reflection distinguishes with IsSZArray. An external member may declare both, and collapsing them would make those overloads indistinguishable. kotc MUST omit it.

tByRef.description: a CLR by-ref `ref T`. Replaces byRef:X.

tPtr.description: CIR-only: a CLR unmanaged pointer `T*`. BIR carries the semantic kotlin.clr.ClrPointer<T> vocabulary; bir2cir selects this physical form for values and exact native signatures. kotc MUST omit it.

tFnPtr.description: CIR-only exact ECMA function-pointer signature, distinct from Kotlin functions and CLR delegates.

tMod.description: CIR-only: an ECMA custom modifier (II.7.1.1) applied AT ITS SIGNATURE POSITION. Part of member identity — `void V(in DateTime)` and `void V(DateTime)` differ only by modreq(InAttribute) on a by-ref parameter, so a reference that drops the modifier cannot select between them. Nesting (rather than a sidecar modifier list) is what keeps each modifier attached to the exact position it modifies. kotc MUST omit it.

memberRef.description: CIR-only: ONE complete, already-resolved reference to a member of another assembly, authored by bir2cir and consumed by ilemit as an EXACT lookup. It carries every fact needed to construct the intended ECMA MemberRef/MethodSpec, so no consumer performs member SELECTION: zero target matches is a CIR/target mismatch and more than one is a schema/identity defect — neither is a cue to fall back on name, arity, applicability, assignability or most-derived rules. The signature is the OPEN declared one (II.9.8: a MemberRef carries the UNINSTANTIATED signature); method instantiation rides on the node's own `typeArgs` and owner instantiation on `declaringType.args`.

kind.description: What the member IS. Selects the lookup family (method/constructor/field) and records the accessor role; the get-vs-set / add-vs-remove ROLE stays on the node kind, never re-derived from a get_/add_ spelling.

assembly.description: Simple name of the assembly that must own the emitted reference. This is the PHYSICAL identity, not the file bir2cir happened to read: fixing the physical CLR representation is bir2cir's job, so where a reference twin and its runtime twin differ in name this already names the runtime one. Full version/culture/PKT identity is deliberately NOT carried — a reference-pack and its implementation assembly legitimately differ there.

declaringType.description: The exact DECLARING type: an fqn whose name is the open definition's metadata FullName VERBATIM (arity backtick and `+` nesting included — the physical name the target universe is keyed by, so nothing downstream re-derives either) and whose `args`, when present, are the USE SITE's instantiation of that declaring type, projected along the declaration edge. Those arguments are ordinary document type nodes in the document's vocabulary — they are not something the target declares — and a consumer resolves them exactly as it resolves any other type slot. The declarer is stated, never derived — a member the receiver merely inherits is anchored on the type that declares it, so no base walk or most-derived rule is needed downstream.

name.description: The exact metadata member name: `.ctor` for a constructor (and ONLY for a constructor), get_X/set_X/add_X/remove_X for an accessor, otherwise verbatim.

genericArity.description: The member's OWN generic-parameter count; 0 for everything but a generic method. Stated rather than inferred from a call site's type-argument count.

callingConvention.description: The HASTHIS bit, and whether the signature is vararg. Absent for a field. A vararg member is a DIFFERENT member from its fixed-arity neighbour, so the convention states it; whether such a signature can be emitted is a question for the emitter, which is where it can be answered.

parameterTypes.description: The OPEN declared parameter vector (positional `tv`, byref/pointer/array-rank and in-position `mod` modifiers all preserved). Every type name in it is the TARGET's verbatim metadata FullName — arity backtick and `+` nesting included, delegates NOT rewritten as function types, `System.Nullable`1` NOT collapsed — because the document's ordinary spelling merges types an identity must keep apart (stripping at the first backtick turns `Outer`1+Inner` into plain `Outer`). Absent for a field.

returnType.description: The OPEN declared return type — the void fqn for a void method AND for a constructor, and the declared FIELD type when kind is `field`. Part of member identity: an inherited slot can be shadowed by a redeclaration that differs only in return type.

memberRef.$comment: A field carries neither `callingConvention` nor `parameterTypes`; every other kind carries both. A ctor is named `.ctor`, is `instance`, has arity 0 and returns void, and no other kind may bear that name. ONE SPELLING PER SHAPE, since a consumer compares these exactly: a non-generic declarer omits `args` rather than carrying an empty list, and a signature carries no `oblivious` or `star` — those are Kotlin type-system facts, not physical CLR shapes. `declaringType.args` is FLATTENED over the enclosing-type chain, matching tv{scope:type}. A non-nested name states that list's arity; a nested name does not state whether its inner declaration captures enclosing parameters, so bir2cir validates its length against the resolved TypeDef while authoring the reference. The context-free validator pins every other part of the shape.

interfaceSlotSet.description: CIR-only: the complete declared slot set for one exact external interface use. The owner keeps the constructed instantiation distinct, assembly fixes its metadata scope, and an empty slots array is the explicit answer that the interface declares no slots. A consuming type carries one set for every external owner it reaches; omission is not permission to enumerate metadata in ilemit.

pinvoke.description: CIR-only normalized MethodDef/ImplMap descriptor for a CLR P/Invoke declaration. bir2cir consumes Kotlin external + the DllImportAttribute pseudo-attribute into this complete physical instruction; ilemit emits it one-to-one and no CustomAttribute row survives.

callingConventionType.$comment: Exact target enum type for the CallingConvention field in Reflection.Emit's DllImport pseudo-attribute API.

charSetType.$comment: Exact target enum type for the CharSet field in Reflection.Emit's DllImport pseudo-attribute API.

pseudoFields.$comment: Exact DllImport named fields ilemit writes through Reflection.Emit's pseudo-attribute API after bir2cir physical normalization. This is not source presence: CallingConvention is always stated to materialize Winapi, while CharSet.None is omitted because it physically means no charset bits.

attributeCtorRef.$comment: Exact already-resolved DllImportAttribute(String) constructor used only as Reflection.Emit's pseudo-attribute metadata API handle.

mods.description: Order-free set of name:true flags (absent = not set). Replaces the $kmods string-concat + the final,inline,ext,… comma string + scattered flat booleans. Visibility is NOT a mod (see `vis`).

suspend.$comment: BIR-only. The Kotlin `suspend` modifier is consumed by bir2cir — the cold-core lowering rewrites the declaration into a state machine + `$dotkt_suspend` cold entry + Task bridge, and RoundtripMetadata stamps [KotlinFunction(Suspend)] from it. It never reaches CIR; the validator refuses one there.

cirFile.description: Physical output unit. Declaration records contain only typed fields; executable subtrees have a named temporary adapter until node migration.

cirTypeParameter.description: One physical generic parameter declaration, including all constraint rows. Names in expressions are a different domain.

cirExecutable.$comment: Closed physical executable union. Each cirExecutable-domain definition states its tag, roles and exact typed children; source BIR uses a separate vocabulary.

cirScalarValue.$comment: Shared exact physical scalar values, not the full metadata-argument domain. Executable literals do not contain type tokens, byte payloads, arrays, enums or unencodable metadata placeholders.

cirExpressionList.$comment: Constructor delegation operands; explicit null remains distinct from an absent field.

cirExpression.$comment: Field initializer; explicit null states no initializer.

name.$comment: the tv NAME is retained on the DECLARATION; references use positional tv{scope,i}

reified.$comment: BIR-only Kotlin reified type-parameter fact. bir2cir preserves it in trusted round-trip metadata but derives the separate CLR nullable-witness ABI structurally; it never reaches CIR.

erasedInnerConstraints.$comment: bir2cir-only constraints removed from an inner TypeDef because its star-outer physical frame cannot express them. Constrained receiver binding consumes this fact and DROPS it before CIR.

specialConstraints.$comment: CIR-only CLR GenericParameterAttributes copied by bir2cir for a referenced generic receiver's C# 14 extension grouping/wrapper; ilemit emits them one-to-one.

param.description: A value parameter. Nullability lives on `type` (§1). #48 STATUS: FOLDED — the sibling `nullable` decl flag is RETIRED; kotc emits the `?` on the `type` node (`{t:nullable,of:T}`). bir2cir's `DeclNullableFlags` derives the flattened `NullableAttribute` byte array (`nullableFlags`) from the reference-nullable positions of the type before `ReferenceNullableStrip` strips the wrappers.

nullableFlags.$comment: bir2cir-derived flattened NullableAttribute bytes (0=oblivious,1=not-null,2=nullable) for this param's reference-nullable positions; RoundtripMetadata folds it into the param's `attrs` as a NullableAttribute entry, which ilemit stamps. Absent when the type carries no nullable-reference position.

mods.$comment: only vararg/noinline/crossinline/context/extensionReceiver apply to a param; `context` and `extensionReceiver` preserve Kotlin slot roles on physically ordinary positional parameters

default.description: BIR: Kotlin constant expression. CIR: physical metadata constant. Absent = required; source expressions are consumed before CIR serialization.

defaultBir.description: BIR-only source default for cross-module use. bir2cir freezes it into the versioned byte-array metadata carrier before ordinary lowering.

ctxFnType.description: How many of the slot function type's LEADING physical arguments (recv first, then params) are Kotlin CONTEXT parameters: `context(A) B.(D) -> E` is `@ExtensionFunctionType Function3<A,B,D,E>`, so 1 — contexts precede the receiver. Absent = an ordinary function type. fir2ir ERASES the fact (it makes `context(A) B.(D) -> E` the SAME IrType as `B.(A,D) -> E`), so kotc recovers it from FIR and carries it here; bir2cir turns it into [KotlinContextFunctionType(N)]. Without it a consuming module restores the context AS the extension receiver and a lambda's `this` silently binds to the wrong value.

richEnumCarrier.$comment: BIR-only exact Kotlin rich-enum declaration-to-physical-member map. kotc authors it beside enumRich:true; bir2cir consumes it into [KotlinRichEnum] and removes both facts before CIR. Empty entries are valid for a source enum with no entries.

name.$comment: Exact physical instance field carrying Enum.name.

ordinal.$comment: Exact physical instance field carrying Enum.ordinal.

values.$comment: Exact physical static values method name.

valueOf.$comment: Exact physical static valueOf method name.

clrEnumFact.$comment: BIR-only @ClrEnum source contract. kotc has validated the restricted declaration and carries its exact Kotlin integral parameter type here; bir2cir consumes it into an exact CLR underlying type and ordered basicEnum carrier.

basicEnumCarrier.$comment: bir2cir transient ordered map for every Kotlin-authored basic enum. RoundtripMetadata consumes it into trusted [KotlinBasicEnum]; declaration entries retain their physical literal facts for ilemit.

kind.description: delegate is CIR-only: an exact CLR delegate declaration carrying params/ret and an arity-qualified metadata name

generated.description: #68: compiler-generated synthetic (closure/ref-cell/KProperty/CharSequence/ClrH/lifted-anon); ilemit stamps [CompilerGenerated] from it — replaces the retired `<>dotkt_` name-sniff

enumRich.$comment: BIR-only faithful fact that this class originated as a Kotlin rich enum. It is present exactly when richEnum is present and bir2cir consumes both before CIR.

underlying.$comment: CIR-only exact CLR underlying type for a basic enum; ordinary Kotlin enums select Int32 and explicit CLR enums select their declared integral representation.

semanticOwner.description: #225 BIR-only lexical Kotlin owner identity. bir2cir consumes this fact and selects the CLR nested owner.

staticSemanticOwner.description: BIR-only lexical owner of a lifted local/anonymous implementation declared inside a Kotlin-static member. The type does not capture that owner's generic frame; bir2cir consumes this fact when selecting physical ownership.

nestedIn.description: CIR-only physical CLR enclosing type selected by bir2cir.

kotlinCompanion.description: #275 BIR semantic fact on a companion declaration. bir2cir consumes it when selecting the ordinary nested CLR carrier and emits explicit round-trip metadata.

staticCarrier.$comment: bir2cir-only explicit association on the non-generic physical carrier of a generic Kotlin owner's companion-block static surface. RoundtripMetadata consumes it into trusted [KotlinStaticCarrier]; dll2klib merges the carrier declarations back into owner.

capturedTypeParams.description: CIR-only enclosing CLR generic slots physically re-declared by a nested type. A bare name is unconstrained; a typeParam object preserves Kotlin outer constraints.

outerTypeParamCount.description: #225 BIR-only number of typeParams inherited semantically from the lexical Kotlin owner. bir2cir projects these declarations to the leading capturedTypeParams CLR slots.

outerTypeParamOffset.description: #225 BIR-only start of the outerTypeParamCount segment in semantic typeParams order. Absent means zero; lifted local/anonymous implementations keep own params before lexical-owner params until bir2cir chooses CLR slot order.

inheritedDefaultAccessors.$comment: BIR-only frontend-selected inherited default property implementations on a class. Each entry states the class-frame Kotlin signature and exact Kotlin declaration identity; bir2cir consumes it when deciding whether CLR MethodImpl allocation is required and never re-resolves the implementation from hierarchy bodies or names.

typeParams.$comment: Exact frontend-selected target declarations, including generic constraints.

inheritedClassMethods.$comment: BIR-only inherited method signatures with the frontend-selected class implementation and override closure. These are facts, not new declarations or bodies. bir2cir uses them to allocate signature bridges to inherited implementations.

inheritedDefaultMethods.$comment: BIR-only frontend-selected inherited default ordinary-function implementations on a class. This is the method twin of inheritedDefaultAccessors and is consumed only for explicit CLR MethodImpl allocation when another physical method would capture the DIM slot.

typeParams.$comment: Exact frontend-selected target declarations, including generic constraints.

entries.description: enum entries; a basic CIR enum entry carries name/ordinal/underlying/physicalValue and may carry attrs authored by bir2cir for mechanical field stamping

pos.$comment: #112 P2: OPTIONAL decl-level SOURCE POSITION (File.kt:line), threaded kotc -> BIR -> CIR so an ilemit/bir2cir emit failure or a shared IrSanity violation points at the originating declaration. Diagnostics-only; absent = pre-#112 behavior (a synthetic with no source omits it). Numeric l/c so the schema validator's bare-string check is not tripped; pos.f is the one string (verify-schema.py STR_OK).

l.description: 1-based line; absent/-1 when only the file is known

sourceSpan.description: An authored Kotlin source document and a one-based, end-exclusive source range.

methodImplDescriptor.$comment: CIR-only exact ECMA-335 MethodImpl declaration identity authored by bir2cir and consumed one-to-one by ilemit.

typeParams.$comment: Optional exact generic-parameter declarations, including constraints, when CLR overloads otherwise share member/arity/params/ret.

memberRef.$comment: Required when clrBaseImpls names a declaration in another assembly; bir2cir resolves the descriptor and ilemit links this identity one-to-one.

generated.description: Compiler-generated method declaration (materialized lambda/local-function/callable-reference target or a lowerer synthetic). ilemit maps this CIR fact 1:1 to [CompilerGenerated]; dll2klib excludes the method from the restored Kotlin API.

retCtxFnType.$comment: The RETURN-position twin of a parameter's `ctxFnType`: how many of the returned function type's LEADING physical arguments are Kotlin CONTEXT parameters. fir2ir erases the fact, so kotc recovers it from FIR; bir2cir folds it into the method's `retAttrs` as [KotlinContextFunctionType(N)]. Absent when the return is not a context function type.

retNullableFlags.$comment: #48: bir2cir-derived flattened NullableAttribute bytes for the RETURN's reference-nullable positions (the retired scalar `retNullable` flag's replacement); RoundtripMetadata folds it into the method's `retAttrs` as a NullableAttribute entry, which ilemit stamps on the return parameter. Absent when the return carries no nullable-reference position.

static.$comment: a load-bearing CLR-shape flag, kept scalar (not a Kotlin source modifier)

kotlinStatic.$comment: BIR-only frontend fact distinguishing a Kotlin 2.4 companion-block static from other compiler/static CLR methods. GenericStaticOwnerBinding consumes it when selecting a non-generic physical carrier.

companionReceiver.$comment: #382: the bare Kotlin classifier a COMPANION EXTENSION (`companion fun C.foo()`) is semantically associated with, as a serialized argument-free fqn type node. Receiverless: the association is not a parameter and nothing is passed at the call. A STRING so CLR type lowering leaves the Kotlin identity untouched.

companionSourceName.$comment: BIR-only source declaration name for a companion extension. bir2cir may choose a different collision-free physical CLR name; RoundtripMetadata records this source identity in [KotlinCompanionExtension].

companionMemberKind.$comment: BIR-only explicit declaration role for companion-extension methods. bir2cir and round-trip consumers must not infer accessor identity from a get_/set_ spelling.

propertyName.$comment: #397 BIR-only Kotlin source property identity carried by every accessor declaration. bir2cir allocates the CLR MethodDef name from this plus propertyAccessor; consumers must never recover it from a physical method spelling.

propertyAccessor.$comment: #397 BIR-only explicit getter/setter role. It survives every semantic bir2cir consumer and is removed at the CIR boundary.

propertyAssociation.$comment: #397 BIR-only file-local association shared by one Property record and its exact accessor declaration(s). This disambiguates same-name accessors with different context/extension receivers without introducing the general declaration identity deferred to #395.

inheritedImplementation.$comment: BIR-only concrete Kotlin declaration selected by frontend fake-override resolution. Presence means this fake override inherits an implementation; bir2cir consumes the fact directly instead of inspecting ancestor bodies or CLR metadata.

typeParams.$comment: Exact frontend-selected target declarations, including generic constraints.

sig.$comment: Selected declaration parameter vector in the callee formal generic frame; required when materializing a suspend forwarding call.

physicalSlotBridge.$comment: bir2cir-internal role fact: this generated declaration exists only as a CLR MethodImpl forwarding body and must not participate in Kotlin declaration binding. Descriptor presence alone is insufficient because a source accessor may directly carry a MethodImpl for an external property slot.

clrInterfaceSlotBridge.$comment: CIR-only instruction: this private interface MethodDef is the final forwarding body of an explicit MethodImpl. ilemit maps it to Private|Virtual|Final|NewSlot without inferring the role from its name or body.

clrInterfaceImpls.$comment: CIR-only exact interface declaration slots implemented by this MethodDef.

clrBaseImpls.$comment: CIR-only exact base-class declaration slots implemented by this MethodDef.

requiresClrOverride.$comment: CIR-only MethodImpl emission instruction for an external base virtual. When true it requires clrOverrideRef; the boolean states the operation role, not a second member identity.

clrOverrideRef.$comment: CIR-only exact external base virtual implemented by this MethodDef. This scalar is the complete MethodImpl target; requiresClrOverride is its independent emission instruction, never a parallel owner/name/signature descriptor.

baseCtorRef.$comment: CIR-only exact external base constructor invoked by this constructor delegation. No parallel owner/signature descriptor is permitted.

delegationDeclarationId.$comment: BIR-only frontend-selected Kotlin constructor identity for this/base delegation; consumed into exact localCtorIndex or baseCtorRef.

declarationId.$comment: #395 BIR-only frontend-authoritative stable Kotlin declaration fingerprint. bir2cir allocates the physical MethodDef and binds uses from this key after CLR erasure; RoundtripMetadata consumes it into [KotlinDeclarationIdentity].

declarationSourceName.$comment: #395 bir2cir hand-off preserving the Kotlin source name when declarationId receives a different physical CLR name. Consumed into [KotlinDeclarationIdentity] before CIR.

explicitClrName.$comment: #402 BIR-only source-authored physical MethodDef name from @ClrName or its @JvmName compatibility alias. bir2cir validates and consumes it during final CLR signature allocation; it is forbidden in CIR.

extern.$comment: CIR-only: bodyless CLR extern method. bir2cir uses this for caller-side UnsafeAccessor declarations; ilemit defines the signature/attributes one-to-one and emits no IL body.

pinvoke.$comment: CIR-only normalized CLR MethodImport descriptor; requires extern:true and a bodyless static non-generic declaration.

bodyTerminates.$comment: CIR-only proof that the authored body cannot fall through. ilemit therefore emits no synthetic trailing return.

clrFinal.$comment: CIR-only physical MethodAttributes.Final flag for a sealed virtual slot; authored by bir2cir from declaration modality.

abstract.$comment: Declaration modality fact. In particular, a concrete interface Unit method may have an empty body array, so consumers must never derive abstractness from body presence.

_syntheticTypeArgs.$comment: BIR-only correspondence from a lexical local function's dense parameters to its enclosing frame. LocalFunctionLowering uses it to partition physical owner and method slots, then removes it.

lexicalOwnerTypeParamCount.$comment: bir2cir-internal hand-off: a materialized local suspend MethodDef on a generic semantic owner retains this many leading owner slots when SuspendColdLowering moves its body into a state-machine TypeDef. Consumed before CIR.

getRet.$comment: CIR-only exact getter MethodDef return type, in its declaration frame.

setRet.$comment: CIR-only exact setter MethodDef return type, in its declaration frame.

getSig.$comment: CIR-only bir2cir-resolved CLR getter parameter signature. ilemit uses it with get/getMethodArity/getRet as an exact MethodDef link rather than selecting by name.

setSig.$comment: CIR-only bir2cir-resolved CLR setter parameter signature, including the value parameter.

kotlinAccessors.$comment: #397 BIR-only accessor-presence facts for a Kotlin Property declaration. bir2cir consumes them into physical get/set MethodDef links; kotc does not choose those CLR names.

propertyAssociation.$comment: #397 BIR-only exact association with this Property record's accessor declarations. Required whenever kotlinAccessors is present and removed at the CIR boundary.

kotlinStatic.$comment: BIR-only frontend fact identifying a Kotlin 2.4 companion-block property. GenericStaticOwnerBinding consumes it when moving the property and its accessors to a non-generic physical carrier.

nullableFlags.$comment: #48: bir2cir-derived flattened NullableAttribute bytes for the slot's reference-nullable positions (replaces the retired scalar `nullable` flag).

static.$comment: the field is storage of the TYPE, not of an instance: a top-level property's file-class field, an `object`/enum-entry singleton, or a Kotlin 2.4 `companion { }` property's backing field. A static field's `init` runs in the type initializer. Like funDecl.static, a CLR-shape flag rather than a Kotlin source modifier.

kotlinStatic.$comment: BIR-only companion-block declaration fact; consumed by GenericStaticOwnerBinding and absent from CIR.

init.$comment: the initializer expression of a STATIC field, emitted into the type initializer. An instance field is initialized by its constructor instead and carries no `init`.

const.$comment: BIR-only Kotlin declaration fact. bir2cir requires a static compile-time-constant initializer and consumes both into the CIR `constant` value.

constant.$comment: CIR physical field constant. ilemit emits a CLR static literal field and ECMA-335 Constant row; there is no executable initializer.

lateinit.$comment: Kotlin round-trip declaration fact. bir2cir authors private object storage with typed checked accessors and trusted [KotlinLateinit] metadata. The checked object read is explicit `lateinitGet`; its CIR form carries the fully bound UninitializedPropertyAccessException construction in `exception`.

lateinitDeclarationId.$comment: BIR-only exact Kotlin getter declaration identity of the property owning this lateinit storage. bir2cir binds lexical initialization queries by this identity and consumes it before CIR.

readOnly.$comment: Kotlin round-trip metadata: a val, or a var whose setter is more restricted than the property, is restored as val on the projected property surface. bir2cir folds it into [KotlinReadOnly]; distinct from the physical `initOnly` below.

companionReceiver.$comment: #382: the funDecl twin — the Kotlin type a field-backed COMPANION EXTENSION property (`companion val C.bar = 1`) is associated with, as a serialized type node.

companionSourceName.$comment: BIR-only source property name retained independently of the collision-free physical field name.

companionMemberKind.$comment: BIR-only explicit field role; companion property accessors use funDecl get/set instead.

companionPropertyMutable.$comment: BIR-only Kotlin val/var fact for a field-backed companion extension. Unlike readOnly, this remains true for a var whose setter is non-public; bir2cir consumes it when synthesizing the physical setter.

companionSetterVisibility.$comment: BIR-only visibility of a field-backed companion extension var's default setter. Required when companionPropertyMutable is true and consumed by bir2cir.

companionStorageReadOnly.$comment: BIR-only storage-mutability fact. Distinct from the public Kotlin readOnly surface: a private-set var remains mutable storage, while delegated storage is assigned once. bir2cir consumes it into CIR initOnly.

companionGetterExplicitClrName.$comment: #402 BIR-only @ClrName/@JvmName value for the default getter synthesized by bir2cir for a field-backed companion extension.

companionSetterExplicitClrName.$comment: #402 BIR-only @ClrName/@JvmName value for the default setter synthesized by bir2cir for a field-backed companion extension.

companionGetterDeclarationId.$comment: #402 BIR-only frontend declaration identity paired with companionGetterExplicitClrName; transferred to the synthesized getter MethodDef.

companionSetterDeclarationId.$comment: #402 BIR-only frontend declaration identity paired with companionSetterExplicitClrName; transferred to the synthesized setter MethodDef.

initOnly.description: CIR physical field flag: emit CLR initonly (C# readonly). bir2cir authors it only when the CLR storage itself is immutable; distinct from Kotlin readOnly round-trip metadata.

nullableFlags.$comment: #48: bir2cir-derived flattened NullableAttribute bytes for the slot's reference-nullable positions (replaces the retired scalar `nullable` flag).

node.description: Every node is a {k}-tagged object. ~60 canonical kinds; k + all field names are lowerCamelCase. A type-valued field always holds a $defs/type. Dispatch on k; never scan a string.

calleeRet.$comment: CIR-only exact local MethodDef return signature in the callee declaration generic frame, authored by bir2cir for identity-bound calls and delegate targets. Not a caller-side result approximation.

calleeParams.$comment: CIR-only exact local MethodDef parameter signature in the callee declaration generic frame, including custom modifiers. When present, this is the linkage vector; sig remains the call's value-slot vector.

companionReceiver.$comment: BIR-only use-site identity for a receiverless companion-extension call, delegate, or field access. bir2cir resolves it together with owner, source member name, and explicit operation role, then removes it.

lateinitSourceName.$comment: bir2cir-only transient source property identity retained when companion-extension binding replaces a lateinitGet's field name with its collision-free physical name. LateinitGetLowering consumes it into the exception message and removes it before CIR.

lateinitDeclarationId.$comment: BIR-only exact frontend-selected Kotlin property getter identity on lateinitIsInitialized. This names the property declaration, not an executable checked-read target.

volatile.$comment: CIR-only access fact. bir2cir authors it on direct field, CLR-field-as-property, and UnsafeAccessor byref dereference nodes; ilemit emits the volatile. prefix one-to-one.

exception.$comment: CIR-only `lateinitGet` failure expression. bir2cir authors the exactly bindable UninitializedPropertyAccessException construction; ilemit evaluates and throws it one-to-one when the loaded value is null.

receiverMode.$comment: CIR-only required clrGenericInstance receiver edge, selected by bir2cir from the exact native owner. ilemit addresses the original location or loads the receiver value exactly as stated.

dispatch.$comment: CIR-only dispatch selected by bir2cir, required on clrInstance and clrGenericInstance. The emitter must not infer virtual/base dispatch from MethodInfo flags.

nodeKind.$comment: Representative kotc-emit set. The AUTHORITATIVE frozen kind set (the union of every kind the toolchain emits across a full fresh build, incl. the CLR-lowered `clr*`, coroutine-lowered `co*`, structured `for`, and the not-yet-merged `setFieldExpr`/`staticFieldSet` field-write variants) lives in the m6 validator's KINDS (scripts/verify-schema.py; regenerate with --dump-kinds). The validator rejects any k outside it. (cond = ternary expression; if = statement.)

nodeByKind.$comment: Representative canonical shapes; the validator pins the full per-kind field set. Canonical field vocabulary below.

leave.$comment: CIR-only mandatory physical opcode fact on break/continue/goto/brIf. Authored by bir2cir from final exact region ownership; never inferred by ilemit.

loopId.$comment: CIR-only exact physical loop identity, mandatory on structured loops and their break/continue edges. Replaces Kotlin label selection at the emission boundary.

oneOf.$comment: BIR-only lexical initialization query. Receiver expression and constructed Kotlin declaration owner are retained when present; bir2cir independently binds the selected declaration's physical state, without invoking its checked getter.

joinNullBranch.$comment: BIR-ONLY frontend fact (#86 §3): the frontend resolved this value-position JOIN to a NON-nullable type while some branch yields a literal null. Stamped by kotc on the declaration it MINTS for the join (a try-expression temp, each cond of a when chain); consumed and REMOVED by bir2cir ValueJoinNullWidening, which widens a VALUE join to Nullable<V> and leaves a reference join alone. Never reaches CIR.

memberVisibility.$comment: BIR-only frontend fact retained by inline/default carriers; bir2cir consumes it when CLR ownership requires a caller-side UnsafeAccessor.

memberOwnerTypeParams.$comment: BIR-only generic declaration frame of the accessed owner.

memberMethodTypeParams.$comment: BIR-only generic declaration frame of the accessed method.

memberReturnType.$comment: BIR-only declaration return type, before call-site substitution.

prop.$comment: A2 step 3/4: BIR-only accessor role. For get/set, `method` is the bare Kotlin property name; bir2cir resolves an external Property/MethodSemantics association or applies its one-way allocator for a synthetic Kotlin accessor. For index-get/index-set, `method` is the faithful get/set operator and bir2cir resolves the CLR default indexed Property accessor, including IndexerName. Never in CIR.

clrFlagsOperation.$comment: BIR-only exact frontend-selected CLR [Flags] operation role; bir2cir consumes it into physical enumBits operations.

calleeOwner.$comment: #199 Design B: OPTIONAL FIR-resolved callee file-class DISPATCH hint on an owner:null (top-level) callStatic. Advisory (the owner-null substitution/recognition axis IGNORES it); ONLY ilemit dispatch consults it, to disambiguate two same-simple-name top-level funcs across packages. Mirrors `sty`.

memberVisibility.$comment: BIR-only frontend fact retained by inline/default carriers; bir2cir consumes it when CLR ownership requires a caller-side UnsafeAccessor.

prop.$comment: A2 step 3: BIR-only accessor role with bare Kotlin property name in `method`; bir2cir resolves exact referenced metadata or applies its one-way physical allocator. Never in CIR.

oneOf.$comment: BIR-only inline-call semantic carrier. semanticOwner is the caller's lexical Kotlin owner; InlineSplice uses it for synthesized declarations and bir2cir consumes it before CIR.
BIR-only explicit reference to a lexical localFun declaration. bir2cir resolves id in lexical scope and authors the physical callStatic owner/name.
BIR-only callable reference to a lexical localFun declaration.
BIR identity operator === survives in inline payloads until physical operand coercion; emitted CIR uses == with explicit conversions.
was `un`; the single operand is `e` (the canonical one-sub-expr field, shared with conv/cast/isInst/cond/if/nullable*)
primitive conversion; `k` gives this shared field its Type role (for/forRange.to is an expression)

reifiedTypeOperand.$comment: BIR-only Kotlin fact: an explicit cast or safe cast whose runtime operand is a reified source type parameter, directly or as an array component (including nested arrays). Generic classifier arguments alone do not imply a reified check. Distinguishes a checked reified cast from an unchecked ordinary type-parameter cast; bir2cir consumes it before CIR.

nullMatches.$comment: null answers TRUE — the Kotlin type operand was statically nullable (`x is T?`).

nullWitness.$comment: CIR Boolean expression deciding whether null matches an open type operand whose call-site nullability is dynamic. bir2cir derives and authors it; ilemit emits it one-to-one without reconstructing Kotlin semantics.

oneOf.$comment: was `isinst`

joinNullBranch.$comment: BIR-ONLY frontend fact (#86 §3): the frontend resolved this value-position JOIN to a NON-nullable type while some branch yields a literal null. Stamped by kotc on the declaration it MINTS for the join (a try-expression temp, each cond of a when chain); consumed and REMOVED by bir2cir ValueJoinNullWidening, which widens a VALUE join to Nullable<V> and leaves a reference join alone. Never reaches CIR.

oneOf.$comment: ternary expression

volatile.$comment: CIR-only referenced-field access fact; ilemit emits the volatile. prefix one-to-one.

memberVisibility.$comment: BIR-only frontend lexical-access fact; consumed by bir2cir UnsafeAccessor lowering.

memberType.$comment: BIR-only frontend-resolved field declaration type for cross-module lexical access; never inferred from an assigned value.

generatedEqualsFieldRead.$comment: BIR-only frontend fact identifying a field read inside compiler-generated data/value-class equality; consumed and removed by bir2cir when an existential peer requires the canonical getter slot. Never reaches CIR.

volatile.$comment: CIR-only referenced-field access fact; ilemit emits the volatile. prefix one-to-one.
CIR-only referenced-field access fact; ilemit emits the volatile. prefix one-to-one.

constructorDeclarationId.$comment: BIR-only frontend-selected Kotlin constructor declaration identity; consumed into exact localCtorIndex or memberRef before CIR.

argTypes.$comment: Required in BIR and same-unit CIR: the declaration-owned constructor parameter vector aligned one-to-one with args. External CIR consumes this vector into memberRef.

memberRef.$comment: CIR-only exact external constructor identity; replaces argTypes for external constructions.

localCtorIndex.$comment: CIR-only exact same-unit constructor identity; same-unit CIR retains argTypes for argument coercion.

memberSignature.$comment: BIR-only frontend-selected constructor declaration signature before call-site substitution, including compiler-authored enclosing/capture slots. bir2cir consumes it into exact same-unit localCtorIndex linkage; it never reaches CIR.

funcType.$comment: Static type of the function value invoked by the fill loop; operation-level because init may be a local whose transient sty is removed before CIR.

invokeRef.$comment: CIR-only exact Invoke used by the array fill loop; carried by the operation because init may be a plain stored function value.

synthClass.$comment: #52 BIR-ONLY transient: the ingredient bag for bir2cir's ClosureSynthesis to ASSEMBLE the closure class (name + capture fields{name,type} + invoke params/ret/body + optional generic typeParams). STRIPPED in CIR — the lean node (closureType+captures values+funcType+typeArgs) is what ilemit consumes for the `new`.

typeParams.$comment: The synthesized state machine's complete semantic declaration frame. Names, variance, reification and bounds belong to the same slots; typeArgs independently states their enclosing construction arguments.

typeArgs.$comment: SM construction channel (#75 Batch B, 2A): the ORIGINAL enclosing tvs (type-USAGE nodes, any scope/index) the open SM is INSTANTIATED with — `new smName<typeArgs…>(…)`. Distinct from `typeParams` (the SM's DECL names). Every generic newSuspendLambda must carry exactly one entry per typeParams item; omission is malformed internal ABI and is never reconstructed positionally. A non-generic node may omit it.

capValues.$comment: OPTIONAL per-capture construction-value overrides (positional, aligned with `captures`; a null slot falls back to the descriptor-name synthesis). Set by SuspendColdLowering (GAP 2, an SM-vocabulary spill) and by InlineSplice 2B (an `__outer` rebound to the splice's receiver temp).

funcType.$comment: Canonical Kotlin function type. An extension receiver is carried only in fn.recv; fn.params contains regular parameters. The physical node params array remains receiver-first because it supplies SM field names/create arguments.

oneOf.$comment: suspendRet = the T of Continuation<T> (was `resultType`)
#275 BIR-only semantic companion singleton access; bir2cir binds it to the trusted nested CLR carrier and no instance survives to CIR.
CIR-only CLR-static callable-reference construction. Its external target is the complete scalar memberRef; ilemit performs no member selection.

Enum value construction. BIR carries a frontend-resolved entry identity (and optionally the local ordinal); a local intrinsic may carry its proven ordinal directly; bir2cir authors the CIR physical form as the declared enum type plus exact underlying type/value. The physical form deliberately need not name an entry so flags combinations remain representable without name recovery.
CIR-only exact physical reinterpretation between a CLR enum and its declared integral storage type; bir2cir authors it and ilemit emits it one-to-one.
BIR-only Kotlin enum name operation. bir2cir resolves a trusted rich-enum metadata field or lowers a CLR enum to its virtual ToString slot.
Typed CIR ordinals carry an ordered physical map, including native references and explicit Kotlin enums. Ordinary local basic enums remove type because ordinal equals value.

Explicit Kotlin and imported native enums carry their declaration-ordered physical constants. Ordinary local basic enums have contiguous values; open generic operations are lowered to the ordered runtime helper rather than this opcode.
value-type nullable wrap; operand `e`, element type `elem` (shared with nullableValue/nullableHasValue/nullableNull)
BIR-only lexical Kotlin local-function declaration. The nested declaration is the semantic ownership fact; bir2cir consumes it into a physical MethodDef.
Source boundary, no executable operation. An absent span marks a hidden generated range. Lowering preserves the original source document and range.

joinNullBranch.$comment: BIR-only frontend fact: this block passes through a null-yielding result. ValueJoinNullWidening consumes and removes it before CIR, as for var/cond joins.

oneOf.$comment: §2.7: the RESERVATION for a cross-module omitted default. Emitted by kotc ONLY as the `expr` of a default-phase plan binding; bir2cir's DefaultArgSplice materialises the callee's KotlinDefaultAttribute carrier into that binding, and refuses one found anywhere else. Never in CIR.
Only inside a BIR parameter's defaultBir.body: a closed default expression plus its lifted declarations. Frozen before ordinary lowering.
Only inside defaultBir.body: a source receiver token bound by the default splice.
Only inside defaultBir.body: an earlier-argument token bound by the default splice.

§2.7 CALL-EVALUATION PLAN, BIR-only. `bindings` is the call's supplied values in KOTLIN EVALUATION ORDER (dispatch receiver, extension receiver, positional arguments, then the filled defaults in declaration order); `expr` is the call, whose every read of one of them is a `bindRef`. bir2cir's CallEvalLowering lowers it to a `valueBlock` of `var`s (or, for a constructor delegation carried as the declaration's `delegationBindings`, to `preStmts`).
§2.7: a pure READ of the plan binding `id`. Free to clone — cloning a read is not cloning an evaluation. BIR-only.
…remaining kinds in the nodeKind enum follow the same {k, canonical-fields} pattern; enumerated in full by the m6 validator.

binding.description: One value a call supplies, in the plan's evaluation-order position. `id` is the `bindRef` key, minted in a per-producer namespace (kotc `dotkt$bN`, bir2cir `cir$bN`) and re-minted wherever a plan is cloned into another document; the local it may lower to gets its name from CallEvalLowering, in the frame that holds it. `expr` is the value; for a cross-module omitted default it is the `{k:defaultArg}` RESERVATION DefaultArgSplice fills. BIR-only: CallEvalLowering consumes the whole array.

phase.description: where the value comes from; the array order already carries the evaluation order, so this is documentation and diagnostics, not a sort key

kind.description: `address` = a byref/@ClrRefArgument slot's addressable lvalue: an ordering marker only, never storage

stable.description: may be READ more than once (a literal, an immutable local read) — judged ONCE by the producer and consumed, never re-derived

type.description: the CALLER-instantiated semantic type of the value

role.description: the source-level phrase a storage refusal names the value by ("receiver of 'copy'"); travels onto the lowered `var`

cirAttributeApplication.description: Physical CIR attribute application. Argument values are metadata, not executable children. bir2cir authors the physical constants; ilemit encodes them without reconstructing Kotlin expressions.

cirAttributeArgument.description: Closed physical metadata-value vocabulary. Float payloads are IEEE bits, text preserves UTF-16, and bytes are opaque. The bir2cir-authored unencodable marker is encoded as null by the existing encoder (zero/false for primitives); an application is skipped only where its parameter type rejects that value. No Kotlin body is passed to ilemit.
